topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 107 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 32 common project-authored base contract(s) (owneriscreator, confirmedowner, confirmedownerwithproposal). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
